name: Fuck! Motto Yaru★fla: Cool na Kanojo, Kaoruko
original_name: Fuck!もっとやる★フラ クールな彼女・薫子
source:
Due to some reason, I have to pretend to be my cool classmate Kaoruko's boyfriend. Just like a couple would have it, we go to the bathroom together and sleep together too!
"To avoid any suspicion we should do it properly....."
Wait, you can't be serious!? And I fuck her inside shortly afterwards!! I can even choose whether to ejaculate inside or outside!!
Move and talk! It's a popular mobile short adventure game for PC and android!!

translation:
出于某个原因，我不得不假扮冷淡的同班同学薰子的男朋友。为了像对真的情侣，我们一起洗澡，甚至还要睡在一起！
“为了不让人起疑，我们得好好做才行…”
等等，你来真的！？结果我还真就插进去，跟薰子做了起来！！我甚至能选择射在里面还是外面！！
会动，也会说话！风靡手机的短篇冒险游戏，如今也能在PC和安卓上玩了！！
